 Making sure the “from” address is a known sender
 Hovering over any links to ensure they go to real websites

items.snippet: 研究表明，尽管生成式AI可快速产出内容，人类创作者身份仍对自我价值、认同感与心理健康具有重要意义。
items.raw_snippet: While generative artificial intelligence (AI) can quickly produce appealing work, human involvement in creation may still matter to creators themselves, audiences and those who assign credit. This review examines research across creative, communicative and service domains, including art, literature, music, science, marketing and advice. We organize the evidence by evaluator, by the outcome measured and its timing, and by what was compared, including differences in content, in information about [...] identity, and skills. A well-rated result does not reveal the value of a particular human contribution or the consequences of delegating it to AI. Nor is more human involvement automatically better. Choosing to delegate work or selected work tasks to AI can itself express agency. As AI agents become capable of taking on more creative processes, deciding what to delegate may become a central form of human involvement.
